newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-NATWEST TROPHY SEMIFINAL CLOSE SCORE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATWEST TROPHY SEMIFINAL CLOSE SCORE.

text.p: Sussex, chasing Warwickshire's total of 342, were 43 for two off 11 overs at close of play in their NatWest Trophy semifinal at Edgbaston on Wednesday.
Scores: Warwickshire 342-3 innings closed (D.Hemp 111 not out, N.Smith 72, D.Ostler 58, A.Moles 56), Sussex 43-2.
Match continues on Thursday with eventual winner meeting Essex in the final at Lord's on September 6..
